senses.example: He perdido la cartera con las tarjetas.
senses.exampleGloss: I have lost my wallet with the cards in it.

alternatives.reason: LatAm wallet sense; in Spain cartera is the everyday word.
Small purse for coins only; often kept inside the cartera.
In Peninsular usage cartera is a wallet and bolso is the handbag.

notes: In LatAm cartera usually means a handbag; the sense split is exactly why this entry carries a regional alternative.
